gloss: big man; large man; giant of a man

definitions.gloss: big man; large man; giant of a man
definitions.explanation: A man who is conspicuously large in stature — tall and/or heavily built. Can describe someone admiringly or neutrally.

examples.japanese: {大男|おおおとこ}が{立|た}っていた。
examples.english: A big man was standing there.

examples.japanese: {身長|しんちょう}{二|に}メートルの{大男|おおおとこ}が{入|はい}ってきた。
examples.english: A two-meter-tall giant of a man walked in.

examples.japanese: プロレスラーのような{大男|おおおとこ}に{道|みち}を{塞|ふさ}がれて、{動|うご}けなかった。
examples.english: A huge man like a pro wrestler blocked the way, and I couldn't move.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {大|おお} (big) + {男|おとこ} (man). Used descriptively without strong positive or negative connotation. Common in storytelling, news descriptions, and everyday conversation when describing someone's imposing physical size.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大男|おおおとこ}が{現|あらわ}れる: a big man appears
- {体格|たいかく}のいい{大男|おおおとこ}: a well-built big man
- {見上|みあ}げるような{大男|おおおとこ}: a man so big you have to look up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {巨漢|きょかん}: giant man — more emphatic, often used in martial arts or sports
- {大柄|おおがら}: large build — describes body frame, can be used for women too
- {小男|こおとこ}: small man — the opposite
